summary: Module 04 CONTEXT: blameless postmortems ask systemic 'why did the system allow that' not 'why did you'; near-miss reporting rises; Etsy DB drop → confirmation, tested restores, fast alerts.
evidence: Q1: System-framed questions yield defensive-free detail; person-framed questions yield hiding.
Q2: Knowing no punishment increases near-miss reports → better data → fewer real outages.
Postmortem = learning investigation, not punishment memo.
